pageCache.text:
Welcome to Barnwood C of E Primary School
Small School. Big Adventures.
A warm, ambitious primary school where every child is known, inspired and encouraged to achieve their best.
Tel: 01452 617135
Our Location
Click to Send Email
Welcome to Barnwood CofE Primary School - Gloucester's Best Kept Secret!
Nestled amongst the trees, Barnwood is one of Gloucestershire's hidden gems. From the moment you arrive, you'll discover a peaceful, spacious environment where children can learn, grow and flourish.
At the heart of our school are our children. We believe every child is unique, and our staff take the time to get to know each and every one of them—not only their academic needs, but also their interests, talents and passions. Whether your child loves sport, the arts, Lego, dinosaurs, music or reading, we work hard to ensure they feel seen, valued and known.
This personal approach helps create a warm, welcoming community where children feel safe, confident and ready to learn. We know that children achieve their best when they are happy, supported and inspired.
Alongside a broad and balanced curriculum, we offer a wide range of enrichment opportunities across all year groups, helping children to discover new interests, develop their talents and build lasting memories. We are committed to giving every child the very best start to their school journey and preparing them for a bright future.
Choosing the right school for your child is one of the most important decisions you will make. We would be delighted to welcome you to Barnwood so that you can experience our special school for yourself and see what makes our community such a wonderful place to belong.
Looking for a Reception Class place for September 2027?
You are welcome to come and visit us and to see our school in action.
Please click into the following link or scan the QR code on our flyer, attached, to book a school tour. Alternatively, phone our school office on 01452 617135.
